name: Peachlet · Gremlet #38
description:
A peach that floated down the river and kept going. Smells like summer.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Peachlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
